reasoning: The overlapping squares with a star represent a starred collection, saved bookmarks/tabs, photo selects, or a master template. While somewhat abstract and UI-derived, it fits real digital curation tasks like culling favorite photos, organizing browser bookmarks, or building reusable templates, though it can be confused with a plain copy/duplicate icon.
